title: Duecare Chat Agentic Research Wheels
subtitle: v3.16 chat with Playwright web search (no API keys needed)
description: v3.6 / chat-package 0.2.0 (2026-05-06) — 21-dim rubric (added operational_information_provided + harm_enablement_check), use-case-aware analog prompt classifier (multi-lingual: en/tl/id/ne/bn/my/ar/es/vi/si/ta/ur), curator-block JSON governance, judge → evaluator rename. v3.16 - wheels for chat-playground-with-agentic-research. Bundled: duecare-llm-chat / -core / -models. Adds a 5th toggle for live agentic web research via Playwright (real browser automation). Multi-step Gemma 4 loop using DuckDuckGo HTML + httpx + Wikipedia. Open-source, no API keys. Supplements GREP / RAG / Tools with fresh web context for prompts where the local corpus is silent.
